note: Canonical customization patterns. Reviewers reuse these ids; aliases map names used in earlier reviews. Edit to merge or split patterns (see SKILL.md).

patterns.name: Token audience and scope selection
patterns.description: Client option or constructor argument that sets the token audience or scopes for bearer-token auth.

patterns.name: Challenge-based authentication policy
patterns.description: Authentication policy that reacts to 401 / WWW-Authenticate challenges, discovering tenant, scope or tokens from the challenge and re-authenticating.

patterns.name: Authentication policy by credential type
patterns.description: Inspects the supplied credential and installs the matching authentication policy, such as bearer token, key header or shared-key signing.

patterns.name: Gzip request compression
patterns.description: Compresses request payloads before sending.

patterns.name: Client-side request batching
patterns.description: Splits large inputs into size- or count-bounded batches (often with auto-flush or concurrency), sends them and combines the per-batch results.

patterns.name: Partial-failure reporting for batches
patterns.description: Aggregates per-batch failures into an exception, callback or event instead of failing the whole call.

patterns.name: Reshape request parameters and options
patterns.description: Public method takes an options object or differently named, flattened or regrouped parameters and maps them onto the generated operation's inputs.

patterns.name: Typed wrappers over protocol methods
patterns.description: Handwritten typed method that wraps a generated protocol/raw method or private operation.

patterns.name: Hidden or removed generated surface
patterns.description: Makes generated methods, types, constructors or setters internal, or removes them.

patterns.name: Alternative model constructors
patterns.description: Adds model constructors, constructor visibility changes or implicit conversions, often one per variant of a one-of input (URL vs bytes).

patterns.name: String representation of models
patterns.description: Overrides a model's string conversion to return its stored value or a formatted summary of its fields.

patterns.name: Generated model swapped for another type
patterns.description: Swaps a generated model for a shared or handwritten type (CloudEvent, wrapper dictionaries).

patterns.name: Added or renamed model properties
patterns.description: Adds or renames model properties (backward-compatible aliases, computed properties).

patterns.name: LRO operation ID exposure
patterns.description: Extracts the operation ID (often from the Operation-Location header) and exposes it on the poller or result.

patterns.name: LRO poller or result shaping
patterns.description: Overrides begin/poll methods, poller return types, default polling intervals or final-result unwrapping.

patterns.name: Page loops and continuation handling
patterns.description: Implements the page or continuation loop itself: reads next links or tokens from bodies or headers, builds follow-up requests, honors cancellation and decides when to stop.

patterns.name: Service version mapping and validation
patterns.description: Validates, curates or enumerates supported service versions in handwritten code.

patterns.name: Client layered over generated code
patterns.description: The public client is largely handwritten and delegates to an internal generated client.

patterns.name: Service-specific error types and parsing
patterns.description: Defines service-specific error or exception types, or parses error payloads and codes into the standard error model.

patterns.name: Tracing spans around client operations
patterns.description: Opens named tracing spans around client methods or long-lived sessions and records failures before rethrowing.

patterns.name: Typed streaming and session events
patterns.description: Builds or parses typed events for streamed responses and realtime sessions instead of exposing raw frames or bytes.

patterns.name: Ranged or chunked downloads
patterns.description: Downloads content in byte ranges or parallel chunks, computing ranges, validating integrity and reassembling the output.

patterns.name: Retry and backoff behavior
patterns.description: Changes retry defaults, retriable statuses or exceptions, retry budgets or secondary retry endpoints.

patterns.name: Additional request headers
patterns.description: Sets extra request headers (Prefer, x-ms-upn, a default Accept) from typed options or a pipeline policy that fills them only when absent.

patterns.name: Audience misconfiguration error guidance
patterns.description: Catches authentication failures caused by a wrong token audience and rethrows them with guidance on configuring the audience.

patterns.name: Credential-specific client constructors
patterns.description: Constructor overloads that validate a key, token or shared-key credential and build the matching authentication pipeline.

patterns.name: Client with optional or no credential
patterns.description: Builds the client pipeline with an authentication policy only when a credential is supplied, or offers an endpoint-only constructor.

patterns.name: Client construction from a connection string
patterns.description: Parses a connection string into endpoint and credential parts and builds the client and authentication pipeline from it.

patterns.name: Credential traits on client builders
patterns.description: Adds credential and connection-string trait interfaces and setter methods to a generated client builder.

patterns.name: Shared-key credential type
patterns.description: Defines a credential object holding an account name and key or delegation key, with accessors and key rotation.

patterns.name: Client access token and URL generation
patterns.description: Produces a client access token, either signed locally from a key or fetched from the service, and composes it into a connection URL.

patterns.name: Authorization-preserving redirect policy
patterns.description: Replaces the default redirect policy with one that restricts redirect targets and preserves authorization headers.

patterns.name: Service certificate trust validation
patterns.description: Validates the server TLS certificate against a service-published identity certificate or pinned trust store instead of public PKI.

patterns.name: Shared-key request signing
patterns.description: Canonicalizes the request method, headers, resource and query and signs them with HMAC-SHA256 in a pipeline policy.

patterns.name: Permission flag string parsing and rendering
patterns.description: Converts between a set of boolean permission or resource flags and a compact letter string in a fixed canonical order.

patterns.name: Shared access signature generation
patterns.description: Assembles the string to sign for a shared access signature, signs it with an account key and serializes the token into a URL query.

patterns.name: Client-side encryption
patterns.description: Encrypts and decrypts payloads on the client with wrapped content keys, envelope metadata and framing-aware size accounting.

patterns.name: Signed token and receipt verification
patterns.description: Validates signed tokens or receipts returned by the service against cached signing certificates or trusted verification keys.

patterns.name: Logging allowlist for headers and query
patterns.description: Adds service-specific headers and query parameters to the allowlist of values the HTTP logging policy may log unredacted.

patterns.name: User agent additions
patterns.description: Adds an application ID or feature marker to the user agent string sent with requests.

patterns.name: Self-telemetry outcome counters and reasons
patterns.description: Counts successful, dropped and retried telemetry items per type and reports and resets them through observable gauges.

patterns.name: Self-telemetry metrics pipeline lifecycle
patterns.description: Gates, initializes, configures and shuts down an internal metrics provider and exporter based on settings and environment variables.

patterns.name: Request correlation ID propagation
patterns.description: Copies request or trace IDs between the ambient tracing context and request, response or event headers.

patterns.name: Diagnostic logging and events
patterns.description: Emits extra log statements or diagnostic events with timing, labels or masked settings around requests and startup.

patterns.name: Errors rewrapped as meaningful SDK errors
patterns.description: Catches a specific HTTP status or a low-level transport, stream or credential failure and rethrows it as a more meaningful SDK error.

patterns.name: Ignore not found on delete
patterns.description: Treats a not-found response from a delete operation as success instead of raising an error.

patterns.name: Response status classification
patterns.description: Overrides which response status codes count as success or error, or registers a service error parser, for specific operations.

patterns.name: ETag-based refresh with backoff
patterns.description: Polls a resource with conditional ETag requests and refreshes cached values on change, backing off between attempts.

patterns.name: Download stream response wrapper
patterns.description: Wraps a raw download body in a stream object that carries response properties and supports retrying or decoding.

patterns.name: Typed LRO operation wrapper
patterns.description: Wraps a generated long-running operation in a public operation type with typed inputs, wait and result methods.

patterns.name: LRO continuation token and rehydration
patterns.description: Serializes poller state into a continuation token and rebuilds a poller or operation from a saved token or ID.

patterns.name: LRO status and completion mapping
patterns.description: Decides long-running operation status from a non-standard field or by re-reading the resource, mapping states (including not found) to in-progress, success or failure.

patterns.name: Paged item model projection
patterns.description: Maps each generated page item into a public model or typed collection result while keeping the pager shape.

patterns.name: Paging parameter mapping or omission
patterns.description: Renames, omits or maps page-size and filter arguments of a list method before calling the generated pager.

patterns.name: Per-page conditional requests
patterns.description: Sends each page request with its own match conditions, often as HEAD requests, to detect which pages changed.

patterns.name: Realtime connection session lifecycle
patterns.description: Opens and tears down a long-lived realtime connection (WebSocket or platform signaling), adapts its frames or events and tracks session state.

patterns.name: Server-sent event keepalive writes
patterns.description: Writes periodic keepalive messages to a server-sent event stream, synchronized with normal writes.

patterns.name: Mocking model factory methods
patterns.description: Adds or overloads static factory methods that construct output models for testing and mocking.

patterns.name: Numeric time fields as durations
patterns.description: Projects integer or floating-point seconds or milliseconds on the wire into a native duration type on the public model.

patterns.name: Properties exposed as a different type
patterns.description: Wraps a primitive, binary, nullable or loosely typed wire property in a different public type such as a URI, timestamp, coordinate, identifier, byte array or non-nullable value.

patterns.name: Extensible string enums
patterns.description: Defines or reshapes a public string-backed enum or extensible enum type, including case-insensitive lookup and string comparison helpers.

patterns.name: Enum member renames
patterns.description: Gives generated enum members different public names than the ones derived from their wire values.

patterns.name: Model and client type renames
patterns.description: Maps generated model, client, options or factory types to different public names.

patterns.name: Internal accessor bridge for model members
patterns.description: Adds internal helper hooks that let other SDK code read or set otherwise inaccessible model members.

patterns.name: Model equality and hash code
patterns.description: Implements value equality, equality operators and hash codes for model or value types.

patterns.name: Model copy helpers
patterns.description: Adds a method that returns a copy of a model, optionally with some fields updated or defaulted.

patterns.name: Read-only or copied collection access
patterns.description: Exposes a model's list or dictionary through a read-only interface or wrapper, or copies it on the way in or out, so callers cannot mutate internal state.

patterns.name: Default values for model properties
patterns.description: Initializes model properties, nested objects, collections or enable flags to default or inferred values in constructors.

patterns.name: Generic type parameters on models
patterns.description: Adds generic type parameters to request, result and paging types so fields and documents are typed by the caller's model.

patterns.name: Public options or result models
patterns.description: Defines a public options, result or settings model (including provisioning action results with secure outputs) instead of exposing the generated one.

patterns.name: Union option type with factories
patterns.description: Models a parameter that can be one of several literal or typed variants as a single option type with named factory methods.

patterns.name: Range and interval value types
patterns.description: Defines a time interval value type with alternate constructors, presets, parsing and ISO formatting.

patterns.name: Identifier and URL parsing
patterns.description: Parses a resource URI or ID string into a type exposing its component parts such as name and version.

patterns.name: Model inheritance overrides
patterns.description: Changes a generated model's base type or makes a base model abstract with protected constructors.

patterns.name: Common accessor over polymorphic values
patterns.description: Adds a single accessor that returns the value or identifier from whichever variant of a polymorphic or union type is present.

patterns.name: Collection lookup and aggregation helpers
patterns.description: Adds helpers that index, look up by name, aggregate or cache derived views of items in a model collection.

patterns.name: Client-side input validation
patterns.description: Validates argument shapes, required fields, exclusivity or runtime types before calling the service.

patterns.name: Value recognition and parsing helpers
patterns.description: Utility functions that recognize, decode or extract values from strings or settings without calling the service.

patterns.name: Resource-scoped operation shortcuts
patterns.description: Methods on a resource or parent scope that build or reuse a stored resource scope and forward to the child or scope-generic operation, so callers do not pass names or scopes on each call.

patterns.name: Shortcuts with preset or hidden arguments
patterns.description: Exposes a named method that calls a generic or private operation with a fixed payload, flag, resource type or default argument so callers never supply it.

patterns.name: Choose between generated operations
patterns.description: Public method that picks which generated operation to call based on its inputs, a flag or the service version.

patterns.name: Convenience method composing several calls
patterns.description: Convenience method that makes more than one service call, or calls another endpoint, and combines the results.

patterns.name: Batch request builders
patterns.description: Helpers that build and queue typed actions or sub-requests into a single batch request.

patterns.name: File, buffer and URL transfers
patterns.description: Helpers that transfer content between the service and a local file, byte buffer, stream or URL in one call.

patterns.name: Sub-client factory methods
patterns.description: Methods on a client that create child or scoped clients sharing its pipeline, credential and configuration.

patterns.name: Client clones for resource variants
patterns.description: Returns a new client pointing at a variant of the same resource, such as a snapshot or version, or with replaced options.

patterns.name: Rename returning a destination client
patterns.description: Rename operation that builds and encodes the destination path and returns a client for the renamed resource.

patterns.name: Dependency-injection client registration
patterns.description: Extension methods that register client factories with a dependency-injection or client builder from URIs, credentials or configuration.

patterns.name: Tuple deconstruction of a result
patterns.description: Adds a deconstruct method that splits a result model into its component values.

patterns.name: Raw request URL and version filling
patterns.description: Overrides the raw send-request method to format the request URL and API version for the caller.

patterns.name: OData filter formatting helper
patterns.description: Helper that builds a filter expression from fragments and values, escaping values safely.

patterns.name: Existence checks and get-if-exists methods
patterns.description: Convenience method that maps a status-code response to a true or false existence result.

patterns.name: Client factory selected from model info
patterns.description: Factory that queries the service for model information and returns a matching client.

patterns.name: Client constructor shape changes
patterns.description: Overrides the generated client constructor to change parameter order, accepted options, endpoint type or bound context before delegating to the generated client.

patterns.name: Backcompat
patterns.description: Keeps an earlier release's public API working for existing callers: old method signatures and overloads, renamed or retired members, obsolete or deprecated types, and stubs that forward to or explain the current API.

patterns.name: Preview or experimental API markers
patterns.description: Marks public types or methods as preview or experimental with annotations, decorators or warnings.

patterns.name: Documentation or annotation fix-ups
patterns.description: Edits generated doc comments, code snippets or framework annotations on generated code.

patterns.name: Endpoint normalization and rewriting
patterns.description: Normalizes, validates, derives or rewrites service endpoint URLs (scheme, trailing slash, path suffix, secondary host, reverse proxy) before requests are sent.

patterns.name: Client endpoint and context properties
patterns.description: Adds read-only client properties exposing the endpoint or resource names the client was constructed with.

patterns.name: Client options configuration binding
patterns.description: Binds client endpoint and options from an application configuration section.

patterns.name: HTTP method tunneling
patterns.description: Rewrites requests of one HTTP method into POST with a method-override header.

patterns.name: Owned resource disposal
patterns.description: Disposes pipelines, messages or inner clients that the client owns, exactly once, and wires context-manager entry and exit.

patterns.name: Callback registration and dispatch
patterns.description: Registers removable callbacks, replays cached state to new subscribers and isolates failures when notifying them.

patterns.name: Background polling worker lifecycle
patterns.description: Starts, schedules and shuts down a background task that periodically polls or heartbeats a service.

patterns.name: Lock-guarded shared state
patterns.description: Holds process-wide state behind a lock and exposes copies or flags to readers.

patterns.name: Hosted agent server setup
patterns.description: Builds a server host with middleware, service registration, protocol mapping, health endpoints and shutdown handling.

patterns.name: Public extension point contracts
patterns.description: Defines a public abstract interface or hook contract that callers implement to plug in behavior, such as schema validation or session snapshot and restore.

patterns.name: Client-side response cache
patterns.description: Caches responses or lookups on the client with LRU or time-based eviction.

patterns.name: Client-side ID generation
patterns.description: Generates prefixed or partition-aware identifiers on the client before sending requests.

patterns.name: Lazy or optional package exports
patterns.description: Shapes a package's public exports with lazy resolution or guarded optional imports.

patterns.name: Public constants and name registries
patterns.description: Exposes public constants, named aliases or name registries (role names, resource types, durations) derived from the service contract.

patterns.name: Request context from cancellation token
patterns.description: Converts a cancellation token into a request context, reusing a shared instance when cancellation is impossible.

patterns.name: Direct HTTP request construction
patterns.description: Constructs an HTTP request message by hand instead of using a generated operation.

patterns.name: Caller-supplied sync token
patterns.description: Lets callers feed a consistency token into the client's shared token cache.

patterns.name: Raw response metadata placeholder
patterns.description: Attaches or asserts a hidden raw-response property on returned objects.

patterns.name: Completed result as task
patterns.description: Wraps an already-available operation result in a completed task so it matches an async API shape.

patterns.name: Base64 encoding of byte values
patterns.description: Encodes or decodes byte payloads as base64 or base64url strings in requests, responses or model properties.

patterns.name: Pluggable message body encoding policy
patterns.description: Applies a configurable encode/decode strategy (text, base64, none) to message bodies on send and receive.

patterns.name: Union property JSON encoding
patterns.description: Reads and writes a property that can hold several shapes (string, enum, model or array) by serializing the chosen variant to raw JSON.

patterns.name: CBOR and COSE structure parsing
patterns.description: Manually decodes CBOR maps and arrays inside COSE envelopes to extract identifiers, claims or nested models.

patterns.name: Date, time and duration wire formatting
patterns.description: Converts dates, timestamps, durations and intervals between language-native types and the exact string or number format the service expects.

patterns.name: Flag options to include-value list
patterns.description: Turns boolean or flag-enum options into the ordered list of include values the request expects.

patterns.name: Enum and field wire-name mapping
patterns.description: Maps public enum members, field names or sort expressions to differently named or cased wire values.

patterns.name: Wire and public model adapters
patterns.description: Converts between generated wire models and differently shaped public models, renaming, defaulting or restructuring fields along the way.

patterns.name: Typed values stored as JSON strings
patterns.description: Parses and serializes a typed model held as a JSON string inside a generic value field, choosing the type by content type or key.

patterns.name: Responses reshaped into result types
patterns.description: Converts a raw or generated response into the public return value: a deserialized model, a boolean or empty result, header-derived properties or an unwrapped envelope.

patterns.name: Explicit model JSON readers and writers
patterns.description: Replaces the generated JSON reader or writer for a model with explicit property-by-property code.

patterns.name: Conditional or null-aware field serialization
patterns.description: Controls whether model fields are written, omitted, forced or emitted as explicit null based on presence, emptiness or internal state.

patterns.name: Polymorphic discriminator handling
patterns.description: Defaults, normalizes or rejects discriminator values when reading polymorphic models.

patterns.name: Delimited string parsing and joining
patterns.description: Parses or builds a model from a delimited text form such as comma- or semicolon-separated values.

patterns.name: URL and key component encoding
patterns.description: Applies extra escaping or re-encoding to path segments, resource names or entity keys before building the request URL.

patterns.name: Multipart form request bodies
patterns.description: Assembles multipart form-data request bodies from JSON and file parts, with optional files and default filenames.

patterns.name: Multipart batch request with sub-requests
patterns.description: Serializes multiple HTTP sub-requests or changesets into one multipart batch request and maps the per-item responses back.

patterns.name: Request content type chosen at runtime
patterns.description: Chooses the request content type and body encoding at call time from the payload, a public format value or the target endpoint, and maps content types back to formats.

patterns.name: Chunked or buffered uploads
patterns.description: Buffers caller data into blocks and uploads them sequentially or concurrently, reusing buffers and chaining conditions.

patterns.name: Accept alternative input forms
patterns.description: Accepts several input shapes (string, list or model; bytes or URL; id or name) and dispatches to the generated operation.

patterns.name: Resource and collection handle accessors
patterns.description: Accessor that constructs a resource or collection handle from an identifier or the current scope, validating the identifier, without sending a request.

patterns.name: Operations using client-bound parameters
patterns.description: Supplies operation parameters (such as a topic or subscription) from values stored on the client.

patterns.name: Closed enum types
patterns.description: Declares a public fixed-member enum by hand, often hidden or kept for compatibility, with its string conversion.

patterns.name: Collection enumeration through list methods
patterns.description: Implements synchronous and asynchronous enumeration on a collection by delegating to its list methods.

patterns.name: ETag and conditional request parameters
patterns.description: Maps ETags or match conditions to If-Match / If-None-Match headers around a generated operation.

patterns.name: Fluent resource definition staging
patterns.description: Queues creation of a dependent resource, such as an identity or storage account, in the create workflow and wires its result into the parent request.

patterns.name: Client created from deployment outputs
patterns.description: Creates a service client from values a provisioning deployment emits as outputs.

patterns.name: Empty string read as missing
patterns.description: Deserialization hook that treats an empty string like null and leaves the property unset instead of parsing it.

patterns.name: Flattened property over a nested envelope
patterns.description: Exposes a nested property on the parent model, reading it null-safely and creating the missing envelope when it is written.

patterns.name: Typed resource wrapper class
patterns.description: Defines a resource class by hand, with its resource type, data access and constructors, for a resource the generator does not produce.

patterns.name: Read-only properties made writable
patterns.description: Turns an output-only or read-only generated property into a settable one (often with a default), so callers can assign it.

patterns.name: Serialization context type registration
patterns.description: Registers additional types with the package's model serialization context so they can be read and written.

patterns.name: Empty JSON writer stubs
patterns.description: Implements a model's JSON write method with an empty body so the type compiles but writes nothing.

patterns.name: Typed parameter value conversion
patterns.description: Converts typed values (enums, scopes, dates) to the strings a generated operation takes.

patterns.name: Numbers or booleans as JSON strings
patterns.description: Reads and writes a number or boolean property as a JSON string, or accepts either form when reading.

patterns.name: Resource key actions as Bicep expressions
patterns.description: A provisioning resource exposes an action such as listKeys as a typed Bicep expression, returning a typed result whose values are registered as secure outputs, instead of making an HTTP call.

patterns.name: Operations mapped to shared public types
patterns.description: Wraps a generated operation to convert inputs or results to a handwritten public model or shared type.

patterns.name: Missing nested properties bag guard
patterns.description: Returns a model's nested properties object or throws when it is missing because the right variant cannot be created automatically.

patterns.name: Resource API-version constants
patterns.description: Handwritten public constants listing the API versions a provisioning resource supports, usually kept so older versions stay selectable after regeneration.

patterns.name: Resource bound to its data type
patterns.description: Metadata that tells the generator which data model a resource class wraps.

patterns.name: Resource identifier builder
patterns.description: Builds a typed resource identifier by inserting name arguments into the resource's path template.

patterns.name: Managed identity type merging
patterns.description: Combines requested system-assigned and user-assigned identity types into the resource's identity setting.

patterns.name: Resource name constraint metadata
patterns.description: Overrides a provisioning resource's name requirements (length range and allowed characters) used to validate or generate resource names.

patterns.name: REST client wiring with version fallback
patterns.description: Constructs and caches the internal REST client and diagnostics for a resource or collection, choosing the API version by resource-type lookup with a fixed fallback.

patterns.name: Managed identity role assignment helpers
patterns.description: Methods that grant a resource's managed identity a role on a resource or resource group through a shared role-assignment helper.

patterns.name: Resource tag helpers
patterns.description: Adds add, set and remove tag methods on a resource, updating the tags resource or the full resource and returning the refreshed resource.

patterns.name: Serialization delegated to another model
patterns.description: Implements a type's model serialization interfaces by forwarding reading, writing and format selection to another type's serializer.

patterns.name: Non-paged list exposed as one page
patterns.description: Wraps a non-paged list response or an embedded list in a pageable that yields one page with no continuation.
